root_cause.text: The vulnerability is caused by the `dpu_runtime_suspend` function invoking `dev_pm_opp_set_rate(dev, 0)`, which prematurely reduces the voltage rail performance vote to the minimum level while the core clock frequency remains at its maximum, creating an unsafe voltage-frequency mismatch upon runtime resume.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff removes the `dev_pm_opp_set_rate(dev, 0)` call from `dpu_runtime_suspend`, and the CVE description confirms that this operation drops the MMCX rail to MIN_SVS while the core clock frequency remains unchanged, potentially causing instability or system crashes when power is re-enabled.
